title: You stay in a room while you read around, in a room window that looks and works like part of Sefaria

tasks.title: Stay in the room while reading around
The room window, its pill, the mini view, and calls-off in the lobby

acs.text: WHILE the viewer is in a room's context (entered, not minimised or leaving), WHEN the reader goes to another reader page without `ctx` (a link in the reader, a search result, the address bar within the app) THE SYSTEM SHALL put the room's `ctx` back on that address with a replace, keeping the viewer in the room (the session, the bar, publishing when they lead); Back to the page they entered from, a Social page (`/social/...`) or another room's address SHALL still leave this room's context, as spec 013 AC-002 and R10 say
scenarios: AC-001 reading around keeps you in the room

acs.text: WHEN a follower follows a link in the reader THE SYSTEM SHALL keep them in the room on their own ("You are on your own" with Follow again), and Follow again SHALL bring them back to the leader's place
scenarios: AC-002 a follower who reads around stays in the room

acs.text: WHILE the reader is in a room's context THE SYSTEM SHALL show the room window: a card fixed at the bottom inline-start corner (clear of the reader's own controls at the inline-end corner and of its chrome insets) with a live dot and the room's title, the status line, the one action that fits it (Follow again, or Lead), Join call when the server offers calls, the room's page and Minimise, and who is here as a count with an expandable list carrying Follow buttons

WHEN the viewer collapses the room window THE SYSTEM SHALL show it as a small pill with the live dot, the room's title and the status, expandable again with one press; the choice SHALL last for the browser session; the toggle SHALL be a button with `aria-expanded`, and the window a labelled region
WHILE the viewer has a live room they are not in the context of THE SYSTEM SHALL show the same card, compact, with the room's title, "Return to the room" (Enlarge) and Leave
scenarios: AC-005 a live room you are not in

acs.text: WHEN a member opens a room's lobby on a server that does not offer calls THE SYSTEM SHALL say "Video calls are not turned on here." where Join call would be
